note: One entry per shipped duel image: the Gemini request that made it. Render with tools/gen_ref.py --ref <refs> --prompt-file <prompt> --aspect <aspect>, then tools/export_final.py. Image generation is not deterministic: a re-render gives a new picture in the same style, and it needs a new review.

files.role: style concept (Michael picked "night sky magic" from 4 concepts)
files.prompt:
Concept art for a mobile game screen (portrait phone, 9:16) for a 7-year-old boy learning Hebrew vowel marks. Layout is right-to-left: a young kid wizard stands on top of a small stone tower on the RIGHT side, casting a big fireball toward a goofy monster approaching from the LEFT. The fireball is hitting the monster at this exact moment: a huge colorful explosion with sparks, stars and magic particles, screen-shake energy. Above the monster floats a speech-bubble sign. The bottom third of the screen is a spell pad of 6 big rounded rune buttons in a 3x2 grid; each button shows only a simple small glowing dot-and-line symbol on an empty dotted circle (no letters, no words). Top bar: three hearts on the right, a sparkle score on the left, a combo flame badge. Do not write any readable text or letters anywhere. Fun, exciting, magical, not scary.
Style: dark starry night sky, glowing neon runes and magic, purple and gold light, luminous particle effects, epic fantasy but kid-friendly.
